name: Polite copula desu
definition: Predicate copula linking noun phrases to subjects; polite default. Plain da copula introduced later as register variant, not as the base.

name: Ko-so-a-do demonstratives
definition: Four-way proximity demonstrative series (kore/sore/are/dore etc.) anchored to speaker/hearer context.

name: Existence predicates aru/iru
definition: Existence/presence predicates split by animacy; locative phrase + ga order.

name: Past/non-past ta form
definition: Predicate past/perfective morphology -ta; non-past covers present and future.

name: Te-form linkage and sequencing
definition: Verbal te-form chaining for sequence, manner, and reason relations between clauses.

examples.text: 朝起きて、コーヒーを飲みました
examples.translation: I got up and drank coffee

name: Request and permission patterns
definition: Request/permission family (te-kudasai, te mo ii desu ka, potential-based might forms) with softness gradation.
usage_rules: softness varies with pattern choice and register; see ja.strategy.softening

name: Reason marking (node/kara)
definition: Clause-final reason particles; node softer/explanatory, kara more direct causal.

name: Opinion expression (to omoimasu)
definition: Opinion framing by quoting a clause with to + omoimasu; softens assertion.

name: Soft potential and indirectness
definition: Potential forms and indirect constructions used to soften requests and problem statements in service contexts.

name: Relative (adnominal) clauses
definition: Clause pre-nominal modification with no relativizer; in-situ grammatical roles.

name: Concession (temo/ni mo)
definition: Concessive constructions (verb te-form + mo; noun ni mo) marking 'even if / even X'.

name: Written connective discourse markers
definition: Discourse connectives for structured writing (sono tame, tsugi ni, mata, dashi-type) with register notes.

name: Reported speech (to iu/to itta)
definition: Quotative complementation with to; direct vs indirect reporting shifts.

name: Softening and indirectness
definition: Face-preserving softening strategies: hedged openers, trailing conditionals, sentence-final softeners; graded by situation and relationship, not a binary polite flag.
usage_rules: choose via situation typical_registers plus relationship; never teach as single switch

name: Apology and repair routines
definition: Apology/repair sequences in service encounters: acknowledgment, account, next-step agreement; register-sensitive phrasing.

name: Hedging in disagreement
definition: Disagreement hedging (chotto..., kore wa..., soredemo...) maintaining discussion face; context-dependent intensity.

name: Written register selection
definition: Written register choices across email/report/opinion genres; kanji-kana ratio and connective set as register cues.

name: Base hiragana
definition: Base hiragana set including basic long-vowel spellings.

name: Hiragana dakuten/handakuten
definition: Voiced/semi-voiced kana series via dakuten and handakuten marks.

name: High-frequency signage kanji
definition: Kanji frequent in signs, labels, and menus selected by communicative value (subset of KANJIDIC2 data, CC BY-SA attribution tracked in licenses).

name: News-frequency kanji
definition: Kanji covering common news-summary vocabulary, selected by corpus frequency statistics (facts; no copied corpus text).

name: Connected-speech reductions
definition: Common reductions in natural connected speech (vowel devoicing contexts, geminate shortening, contractions) taught as recognition targets, not production errors.
